params.caption: 🎮 Mass Effect actors back fan push to save the series on N7 Day This year's N7 Day on November 7 was the first since BioWare's closure, and fans marked it loudly. Several well-known Mass Effect voice actors joined the growing #SaveMassEffect movement to keep the franchise alive. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 23:09 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #MassEffect #BioWare #GamingNews
